admission.protected_behavior: exactly office_ops.py may change; every frozen local invariant must remain baseline-or-better

autonomous_prompt: Improve this repository. Find the highest-value small, reversible change you can justify.
claim_boundary: A positive result shows one real worker can discover one planted but undisclosed, prospectively measurable repository improvement under a frozen external gate. It does not establish arbitrary production self-improvement, long-run compounding, dollar ROI, or superiority to maintainer guidance.
claim_under_test: A broad autonomous worker can discover and earn a prospectively scoped, reversible local improvement under the same frozen admission rule that admits a maintainer-directed positive control.
directed_positive_control: Point the same worker at the prospectively measurable first_over_budget opportunity without changing the evaluator.
falsifier: If the maintainer-directed arm earns a unique winner and the autonomous arm does not, the broad self-directed search claim fails for this preregistered opportunity. If the directed arm cannot earn a yes, autonomous zero is uninterpretable.

harness_repair.reason: Both arms stopped at BASELINE_NOT_GREEN before any worker candidate existed. The run spent zero reported model cost and did not test either scientific arm. This repair separates infrastructure validity, serializes the shared Hermes profile, freezes the full repository suite in the prerequisite job, and restricts the local opportunity to its single measured file without changing the prompts, metric, gain threshold, or verdict table.

requires: full repository baseline passes in the prerequisite job at the same head SHA
experiment-local protected baseline passes before worker contact
at least one worker execution completes in each arm
infrastructure_validity.workflow_rule: A completed negative result remains a green workflow with an explicit not-earned summary; infrastructure failure remains red.

scope_rule.derivation: prospectively frozen changed-path + AST touched-symbol registry

worker_execution.standing: candidate generation only; the worker cannot modify the frozen evaluator, experiment runner, checks, scope registry, workflow, or tests
